expected_behavior: checks Xcode CLT exists first (points to macos-system-prep if missing) and never runs the two installers in parallel
runs the official install script, then adds the eval brew shellenv line to ~/.zprofile idempotently (grep-guard, no duplicates)
verifies with brew --version, brew --prefix (/opt/homebrew on Apple Silicon) and brew doctor in a fresh shell
offers brew analytics off as an opt-out choice, not silently
does not install any formulae or casks beyond verification

cases.prompt: I want my whole machine reproducible - set up the Brewfile workflow.
expected_behavior: explains dump/install/check/cleanup roles and that this skill owns Brewfile regeneration
uses brew bundle dump --describe and asks before --force overwriting an existing Brewfile
shows mas and vscode entry support and where the Brewfile lives (~/.Brewfile global or repo-tracked file)
warns brew bundle cleanup --force uninstalls anything not listed and requires reviewing the list first
suggests tracking the Brewfile in a dotfiles repo (pointer, not implementation)

cases.prompt: brew works in the terminal where I installed it but not in new tabs
expected_behavior: diagnoses the missing shellenv line in ~/.zprofile rather than reinstalling Homebrew
appends eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)" exactly once and verifies in a fresh shell
checks for accidental Intel-vs-ARM double installs (brew --prefix vs uname -m) if symptoms persist
